anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Wide, shallow convex curve originating from the superior cranial margin and descending towards the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Relatively short, wedge-shaped protrusion with a thick proximal base and acute distal termination.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse angle where the downward slope of the melon meets the dorsal line of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Overall monochromatic cyan luminance profile with high-intensity specular highlights along the dorsal and pectoral ridges.
